page_title: SAS 2-3 EMP | Sassuolo v Empoli 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

90+4' 2 - 3 Perfectly taken free kick! Razvan Marin sends a cross in and Simone Bastoni (Empoli) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes into the bottom left corner and the score changes to 2:3.
90+2' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Uros Racic (Sassuolo) is coming onto the pitch as Armand Lauriente cannot continue after picking up an injury.
89' Substitution. Kristian Thorstvedt will be replaced by Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo).
88' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mattia Destro (Empoli) replacing Liberato Cacace.
88' Here is a change. Nicolo Cambiaghi is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli).
88' Substitution. Matteo Cancellieri leaves the pitch and is replaced by Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli).
83' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
82' A player from Sassuolo commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
80' Substitution. Viktor Kovalenko walks off the pitch and Simone Bastoni (Empoli) comes on as a substitute.
80' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' Gianluca Aureliano sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
78' Celebrations by Sassuolo are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.

77' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Nedim Bajrami sends a cross in from the set piece and Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes inside the left post and the score changes to 2:2.
77' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) takes a direct free kick.
77' Gianluca Aureliano interrupts the game. One of the players from Empoli won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
74' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Empoli was in an offside position.
73' Neat passing move from Empoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
70' Sassuolo concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch so that Cristian Volpato can be given a rest.
67' A player from Empoli commits a rough challenge. Gianluca Aureliano blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
64' Goal! Andrea Consigli gets a hand on the penalty from M'Baye Niang (Empoli), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
64' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
63' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for a foul. Empoli are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
63' Empoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
62' Sassuolo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
58' The resulting corner from Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) is cleared.
56' The game has begun to heat up. Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
55' It is time for a substitution. M'Baye Niang (Empoli) is on for Alberto Cerri.
54' 1 - 1 Goal! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Elia Caprile into the bottom right corner.
54' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
54' Yellow card. Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
54' It’s a PENALTY to Sassuolo after the VAR review! Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) was too forceful with his tackle and Gianluca Aureliano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

53' Play continues despite the shouts by some Sassuolo players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Gianluca Aureliano interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
52' One of the Sassuolo players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
51' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
51' The Sassuolo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up. The possession of the ball – 53:47.
49' One of the Empoli players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
48' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) sends a poor cross in from the free kick that is cleared by the head of a defender.
48' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Empoli is cautioned for aggressive play.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Alessio Dionisi gives a chance to Nedim Bajrami and Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+2' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Elia Caprile, who pulls off a comfortable save!
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Dangerous play by Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli). Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for a foul.
39' The Empoli players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
36' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

34' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
34' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
33' A player from Sassuolo commits a rough challenge. Gianluca Aureliano blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
32' 0:0 – the corner kicks stats.
29' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
26' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Sassuolo for a penalty. Play continues.
23' Handball by Youssef Maleh (Empoli).
22' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.

20' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempts to convert the resulting set piece, but his miskick only goes way over the crossbar. A poor shot! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
19' Gianluca Aureliano blows the whistle, Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is penalised for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Sassuolo.
18' Gianluca Aureliano interrupts the game. One of the players from Empoli won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
15' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sassuolo.
12' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
11' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' 0 - 1 Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 0:1.
10' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) will miss the next game.
10' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Gianluca Aureliano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
10' Empoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

7' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) creates some space for himself and unleashes a strike from long range, but his effort sails just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
6' The referee blows his whistle as Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) was too aggressive in his challenge.
6' A pass by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
4' Razvan Marin (Empoli) hits a dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner from the promising free kick. His shot is stopped by a well prepared Andrea Consigli.
3' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Empoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Sassuolo will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Aureliano was nominated as the referee for this game.
